schoolName: Université de Parakou — Faculté de Médecine
reviewNotes: HOLD — Benin's MESRS lists the University of Parakou as a public university; decree 2016-638 establishes it as a national multidisciplinary university. The World Directory of Medical Schools lists Université de Parakou Faculté de Médecine as currently operational, public, French-language and awarding a Diplôme d'État en Médecine, but this directory cannot supply a current admissions/fee payload. Primary sources found do not expose a current medicine programme page, tuition and mandatory fees, intake/deadline, international admission route, clinical placement detail, accommodation arrangements or programme-specific regulator evidence. The French-language directory record is useful evidence of existence, not enough to make claims of international availability or recognition.
